tasks.short: Design or evaluate human work systems with ergonomic principles.

steps.what: Gather task data for the human work systems.
Apply human factors engineering to reach and load.
Design human work systems to optimize safety and performance.
Evaluate usability and quality against ergonomic principles.
Worker trials the proposed work system.
Issue the work system design.

tasks.design: Task data and a reach and load table can be prepared in {SPREADSHEET}. Designing the human work systems and evaluating them against ergonomic principles stay with the engineer, including a trial with the person who does the work. The design is issued only after that evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Principles were applied from memory, and the trial happened after the design was already issued.
tasks.enabler_now: The load table can be ready first. The design, the evaluation and the trial stay.
tasks.still_hard: A layout that meets a table and the worker cannot use for the real task.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not issue a work system the trial showed people cannot do.
tasks.altitude: Design and evaluation stay. The engineer can hold an issue the trial contradicted.

reach.task: Check the room the work system has to fit
reach.learn: Which layout the building can take without a structural change

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
A calculation that runs is not the same as a result the engineer accepts.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from task records to an issued work-system design. Building the workplace is out of scope.
Structured fields are task, reach, load and principle. The task record produces the load. Fallback: a load seen only in the trial is typed and marked observed.
The trial is not a performance score.
The issued design is approved only after the worker trial. The earlier evaluation is not the approval.
unknowns: Whether a worker can trial the design before issue.
Which body sizes the principles were written for.
research_questions: Which designs need a second trial after a layout change?

already_counted.description: Design choices the load table cannot make
Evaluating the trial against the principles

incremental.description: Keep principle names and load units stable

approvals.approved_version: work system design after the worker trial

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A task with existing load data saves the table. Design, evaluation and the trial stay. The low case is a new task with no records.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write, review or comment on proposals, plans and procedures.

steps.what: Outline proposals, plans and procedures.
Write drafts of the proposals and procedures.

loop.output: Draft proposals, plans or procedures with a source for each claim
loop.check: A claim with no source is deleted
loop.stop: One draft; an empty section stays marked open
loop.why_not_simpler: The prose has to follow this brief, not the last document

steps.what: Review and comment on the documents.
Send the commented proposals to the client.

tasks.design: An outline can be taken from the brief in {DOCS}, and a draft may use only claims that have a source. The engineer still reviews and comments. The client receives the proposals only after that review. The same comments go to the people who will run a procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each proposal was copied from the last one and comments arrived in mail after sending.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting can start from a sourced outline. The review stays.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent procedure that the people doing the work cannot follow.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer stops a comment or a send that the sources do not support.

ambition.what: Give the people who will run the procedure the commented copy, not only the reviewers.

tasks.altitude: Review stays. The engineer can refuse to send a document with an unsourced claim.

reach.task: Trace a test-plan comment back to the requirement
reach.learn: Which comment is enough before a plan is treated as agreed

evidence.claim: A drafted number is usable only when it traces to a record the engineer accepts.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a brief to the sent documents. Approving the client's project is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} template before custom code.
Structured fields are section, claim and source. The brief and notes produce the source. Fallback: a typed claim cannot be sent until a source is named.
unknowns: Whether the audience is the client, the operators, or both.
Which sections are allowed to stay open.
research_questions: Which comments need the author's answer before the document is sent?

already_counted.description: Editing thin sections of the draft

incremental.description: Keep section names and source fields aligned

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A brief with sources saves the outline and the first draft. Review and the send stay. The low case is a proposal that must argue past the notes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train users in task techniques and ergonomic principles.

steps.what: Prepare examples of ergonomic principles.

loop.input: Task description and the principles to teach
loop.output: Examples a person can try, each tied to one principle
loop.check: Engineer cuts an example the task does not contain
loop.stop: One draft; a principle with no example stays listed as uncovered
loop.why_not_simpler: Each task's examples differ, so one course shell is not enough

steps.what: Train users in the task techniques.
Worker practices the technique.
Note which techniques need another demonstration.

tasks.design: Examples can be prepared in {DOCS} from the task and the ergonomic principles. Training users in the techniques stays in the room, with the worker practising. The note says which technique needs another demonstration. It does not score the person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Slides were rebuilt for every class, and follow-up was a memory of who struggled.
tasks.enabler_now: Examples can be ready before the class. Teaching and practice stay.
tasks.still_hard: A neat example the real task does not allow.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer taught the session and will not file a score of a named person.
tasks.altitude: Teaching stays most of this time. The engineer can refuse a note that reads as a performance record.

reach.task: Show the equipment the training has to cover
reach.learn: Which controls the class must handle and which are out of reach

evidence.claim: Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.
A decision about a worker may not be solely automated.
Teaching a technique is done with the person, not by issuing a document.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a task description to a practice note. Redesigning the task is out of scope.
Test an {LMS} page before custom code.
Structured fields are principle, example and technique still to show. The engineer produces the note. Fallback: the note is written by hand if the template invites a score.
The note is not a decision about a worker and not a performance score.
unknowns: How many people can practise in one session.
research_questions: Which techniques need a later watch on the job rather than another class?

already_counted.description: Deciding which technique needs another demonstration
Cutting examples the task does not contain

incremental.description: Keep principle names from turning the note into a score

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated class saves example preparation. Teaching and practice stay. The low case is a task the examples do not fit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research solutions for equipment, procedures, manpower and training.

steps.what: Conduct the research question on the proposed change.
Collect evidence on equipment design, procedures and training.

loop.input: Sources on equipment, procedures and training
loop.output: Pack: finding, source and which change it speaks to
loop.check: Engineer drops a finding the source does not state
loop.stop: One pass; a source with no finding is left out
loop.why_not_simpler: Sources are papers and notes, not one form

steps.what: Compare candidate solutions on one sheet.
Evaluate potential solutions with the affected personnel.
Judge manpower and training changes.
Record the research finding.

tasks.design: Evidence on equipment, procedures and training can be packed in {DOCS} with a source for each finding, and compared in {SPREADSHEET}. Evaluating potential solutions with the people affected, and judging manpower and training changes, stay with the engineer. The record follows that judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sources were reread for every change, and the people affected were asked after the answer was written.
tasks.enabler_now: The pack and the sheet can be ready first. The conversation and the judgement stay.
tasks.still_hard: A solution that wins the sheet and the personnel cannot staff.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer heard the people and will not record a solution they showed will not work.

ambition.what: Reopen the research when the equipment changes, not only at the project start.

tasks.altitude: The conversation stays. The engineer can withhold a finding the personnel contradicted.

reach.task: Explain which equipment change is feasible
reach.learn: Which solutions the hardware can take and which need a new machine

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
A drafted number is usable only when it traces to a record the engineer accepts.
Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a change request to a research record. Buying the equipment is out of scope.
Test {DOCS} and {SPREADSHEET} fields before custom code.
Structured fields are solution, source, manpower effect and training effect. Sources produce the finding. Fallback: a point raised only by personnel is typed and marked as said.
The session with personnel is not a performance score.
unknowns: Whether the people affected can be asked before the record.
How far back the sources should go.
research_questions: Which solutions need a trial rather than a paper comparison?

already_counted.description: Judging manpower the sheet cannot rank
Framing a question the request left open

incremental.description: Keep solution names stable when the research is reopened

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A change with existing sources saves the pack and the sheet. The conversation and the judgement stay. The low case is a change with no prior studies.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Work-system design and training stay. Proposal drafts and research packs move faster.
reach: Validation engineers tracing a test-plan comment
Civil engineers checking the room a work system assumes
skills_to_grow: Commenting a procedure the operator will actually run
Teaching without turning the class into a score
role.ambitious_version: Operators receive the same commented procedure as the reviewers, and a class note never becomes a performance record.
